key_highlights: ASX set to slump as oil surges past US$109 and bond yields spike, dragging miners and banks lower
Oil price explosion driven by Middle East hostilities escalation; TACO trade triggered at $100 level
Housing prices in sharp decline with first-home buyer surge; high-end segment hit hardest while affordable end resilient
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
Australia softens local gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; political backlash from opposition
Austal jumps on US$1.9b acquisition bid; Flagship Resources ups copper stakes amid red metal rally
Australian dollar 'shocker' looms amid commodity-driven volatility
Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on family staples, raising consumer cost-of-living concerns
Bathla collapse rippling through private credit market; NSW budget faces massive stamp duty hit from property downturn
AI data centres to be sited at decommissioned coal plants, signalling energy transition infrastructure build

sectors.trend: Strongly positive; oil above US$109 on Middle East escalation benefits upstream producers. Australia's softened gas reservation rules support LNG exporters.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), and Woods Point (WPU.AX) likely outperform. Gas policy easing reduces regulatory overhang on ASX energy names.

sectors.trend: Negative pressure from surging bond yields and risk-off flows, but copper rally supports Flagship Resources; gold exploration active in WA/NSW.
sectors.implications: BHP (BHP.AX), RIO (RIO.AX), FMG (FMG.AX) face headwinds from yield spike despite commodity strength. Flagship (FLG.AX) and gold juniors (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer selective upside.

sectors.trend: Negative; ASX banks tumbling on yield volatility and housing downturn. NSW stamp duty revenue hit signals property stress. Bathla private credit collapse adds credit risk.
sectors.implications: CBA (CBA.AX), NAB (NAB.AX), ANZ (ANZ.AX), WBC (WBC.AX) face NIM pressure from yield whipsaw and property loan concerns. Rental inflation worry (RBA) complicates rate-cut expectations.

sectors.trend: Mixed; Woolworths price-freeze breach damages brand trust but signals margin pressure. Four-day week trial and Only Fans employment data highlight labour market shifts.
sectors.implications: WOW (WOW.AX) faces reputational and margin risk. WES (WES.AX) may benefit from relative value. Consumer spending under pressure from cost-of-living.

sectors.trend: Negative; housing price crash and high-end segment weakness weigh on property valuations. First-home buyer surge is a positive structural signal.
sectors.implications: ASX REITs (VAN.AX, CGP.AX, DGP.AX) face cap-rate pressure. Residential REITs underperform; commercial/industrial more resilient.

sectors.trend: Positive structural theme; AI data centres at coal plant sites signal energy transition capex. Broadcom 2028 guidance and AMD upside support global tech sentiment.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and power infrastructure names benefit. Global tech (AVGO, AMD) positive but limited direct ASX exposure.

key_themes: Oil shock and Middle East geopolitical risk driving global risk-off
Bond yield surge pressuring growth and rate-sensitive sectors
Australian housing correction with bifurcated market (high-end crash vs affordable resilience)
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Gas policy liberalisation supporting ASX energy and LNG exporters
Private credit stress (Bathla) signalling broader credit market fragility
AUD weakness risk from commodity-driven capital flows
AI infrastructure build-out repurposing coal assets

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike and Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WTI/Brent for sustained $100+ levels; diversify away from oil-importing sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield surge and TACO trade reversal
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; reduce growth equity exposure; monitor 10Y AUS bond yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks and residential REITs; monitor NIM spreads and property loan delinquency data
Hedge AUD exposure; benefit for exporters (mining, ag) but hurts importers and consumer staples

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy dilemma (rental inflation vs growth)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; position for delayed rate cuts; favour inflation-hedging assets
Review exposure to private credit funds; favour listed, transparent credit instruments

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX energy names on oil spike and gas policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil above $109 and softened gas reservation rules create tailwind for upstream and LNG producers

opportunities.recommendation: Selective copper and gold exposure on commodity strength
opportunities.rationale: Copper rally supports Flagship; gold exploration activity in WA/NSW signals sector optimism

opportunities.recommendation: Austal acquisition bid creates event-driven opportunity
opportunities.rationale: US$1.9b bid provides price floor and potential upside if deal terms improve

opportunities.recommendation: AI data centre infrastructure plays at coal sites
opportunities.rationale: Power giant repurposing coal plants for AI compute signals multi-year capex cycle

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank and residential REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing crash, yield volatility, and Bathla credit stress create downside risk for financials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce growth equity duration
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk and bond yield surge pressure rate-sensitive valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as yield spike offers entry point
defensive_moves.rationale: TACO trade and yield surge create opportunity to lock in higher fixed income returns

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from oil-driven yield spike and risk-off flows. Miners and banks lead declines. Energy sector is the sole bright spot. Expect volatility around Middle East headlines and RBA commentary. AUD likely weak. 1-3 month range: ^AXJO testing support with potential bounce if oil stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: Housing correction and RBA rental inflation dilemma create a complex rate path. Gas policy liberalisation and AI infrastructure build-out offer structural growth. Commodity mix (copper, gold, LNG) supports mining sector. Private credit stress may normalise. 6-12 month: ASX stabilises if oil normalises and RBA finds policy balance.
